text: searchForVerificationRequests waits for the current user’s Join or Leave event when invited and removes its RoomMember.membership listener in finally. The direct-verification member wait likewise clears its timeout and listener in finally. These are scoped cleanup patterns to preserve across success, rejection and timeout paths; they do not prove every account listener is removed on shutdown. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Remove temporary Matrix membership listeners on both success and rejection
